name: sigge
description: Write copy that sounds like you, in Swedish or English. Thirteen copy frameworks, writing guides and a check for AI-writing patterns. No account needed.

interface.longDescription: Sigge helps your assistant write copy that sounds like you, in Swedish or English. It brings thirteen copy frameworks, each with named moves and a complete worked example, a writing guide for each language and a check for AI-writing patterns. Write a landing page, an email, an ad or a post, check a draft for AI tells, or get a copy chief review of a text you already have. There is no account and nothing to sign in to. The connection to sigge.si adds 59 perspectives and source search.
defaultPrompt: Write a landing page for our bookkeeping firm.
Check this text for AI patterns.
Review my sales email before I send it.
